mapper.sql: p.platform_id, p.platform_name, p.platform_level, case when p.platform_level = 'MAIN' then p.platform_id else mp.platform_id end as main_platform_id, case when p.platform_level = 'MAIN' then p.platform_name else mp.platform_name end as main_platform_name, case when p.platform_level = 'MAIN' then p.network_env else mp.network_env end as network_env
mapper.select:
select rel.server_id as source_id,
from sup_platform_server_rel rel inner join sup_platform p on p.platform_id = rel.platform_id left join sup_platform mp on mp.platform_id = p.parent_platform_id where p.site_id = #{siteId} order by rel.server_id, p.platform_id

select rel.asset_id as source_id,
from sup_platform_asset_rel rel inner join sup_platform p on p.platform_id = rel.platform_id left join sup_platform mp on mp.platform_id = p.parent_platform_id where p.site_id = #{siteId} order by rel.asset_id, p.platform_level, p.platform_id
